dialogues.speaker: Basima the Fifth
dialogues.text: A-hmm-hmm-hmm~ Now you've played Bing-Bang Finchball, have you not? Now do you agree with me when I say that finches are the cutest?

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Hehe, looks like this cutesy finch game's found its place in your heart. Feel free to play to your heart's content!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm. Y'know, Paimon's kinda sure she remembers playing this game somewhere before!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon even paid attention to Finches out in the wild because she played... and she discovered some little quirks that most people miss!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Basima the... Fifth, right? Maybe if we keep playing the game, we'll be able to relive some of our previous adventurers!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Hmm? You've played before? Wow, that means you and my family are connected!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Bing-Bang Finchball is a traditional game passed down from my maternal great-great-grandmother. We've always used it as a way to welcome guests.

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Other than that, Great-Great-Granny would only play the game with her academic rivals and best friends. She did give away a few copies, though...

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: She would say, "If only the sheer adorableness of finches could supercharge everyone's spirits with love! Then, people would become more patient, and the world would have fewer arguments..."

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: I'm going to keep improving and promoting this game — for the sake of her vision of peace, and to spread the cuteness of Finches!

choices.text: Great! But how do we do that?

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Well, I've thought of just the thing! As you can see, I'm currently promoting Bing-Bang Finchball here, at this most busy of Fontainian ports!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Their lovely name shall spread by aquabus and cargo ship, and when the time is ripe, I will distribute many game boards for free, allowing everyone to play at any time!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Then looks like we really are on the same page... Might I interest you in joining the Ambassadors of Finchpeace?

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: If it's alright with you, just bring a few copies of the game or some flyers with you. That way, you can recommend Bing-Bang Finchball to people you meet during your travels...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And that way, we'll be able to yell that slogan in front of still more people—

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: "Finches are the cutest!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon doesn't think that's hyperbole at all! The people we've met who keep pets are all the patient kind, and they're always really easy to get along with!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you and your, err, maternal great-great-grandmother definitely have a point!

choices.text: Why are you called "the Fifth," by the way?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, yeah! It kinda sounds like you're the descendant of a big-time aristocratic family or something... Wait, does Sumeru even have nobility?

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Hahaha! It's nothing quite that amazing! The name's just a title.

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: It all started with that great-great-grandmother of mine. She wasn't the type to yield or bend, and many academic rivals did she offend... Hoping to get rid of her, they packed her off to the desert, tasking her with researching a life form that didn't even exist, and she went missing immediately...

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: But over a decade later, after everyone thought she was dead, she suddenly reappeared — with both the investigative report and Bing-Bang Finchball.

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Not only did she complete her task, but her personality had also drastically changed, as if she had become enlightened.

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Never again did she get angry with peers who debated her. Instead, she would invite them to play Finchball, and hold discussions with them while they played.

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: In such a harmonious atmosphere, most issues were resolved with ease — in fact, many of those she butted heads with in the past eventually became her good friends and fellow Finchball fans.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, is Finchball really that effective!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Things turned out far better than I expected...

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Marvelous, isn't it? And that is why I firmly agree with my great-great-grandmother's belief that cute finches can bring about world peace!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: It was out of respect for her that her friends bestowed her with a recognizable title. Since I'm the fifth head of the house, I'm the "Fifth."

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: I heard that some of my grandmother's friends are very long-lived, and that when they took copies of the game for research purposes, they even expressed hope that they'd be able to see what Basima the Tenth — and even the Twentieth — would accomplish...

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: And that perhaps we'll finally make "sitting down for a round of Finchball" a custom all across Teyvat, through which all disputes might be settled!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like your ideals really are the real deal. We'll help you out!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Most concise! Well put indeed!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Your cogent words crystallize wisdom most precious. I'll quote you on the back of the Finchball packaging, if you don't mind.

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: In any case, let's continue working together to make people happier. May we turn frustrating arguments into peaceable discussions!

choices.text: We'll talk more about cuteness next time!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Definitely! Also, considering we get along so well, do come back and enjoy the game often, would you?
